title: Minimal norms and determinants of lattices from finite Abelian groups
statement:
Given a finite Abelian group $G$ and a subset $S=\{g_0:=0,g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1}\}\subseteq G$, define
$$L_G(S)=\left\{X=(x_0,\ldots,x_{n-1})\in A_{n-1}:\sum_{j=1}^{n-1}x_jg_j=0\right\}.$$ Determine the minimal norms and determinants of the lattices $L_G(S)$, for general $G$ and $S$.

title: Stability threshold for the rescaled shear-flow equilibrium
statement:
For the rescaled system
\[
U_\tau=\left(\frac{U^n}{\Gamma}\right)_{xx},\qquad \Gamma_\tau=U-\Gamma,
\]
determine the stability of the equilibrium \((\bar U,\bar\Gamma)=(1,1)\). The heuristic prediction is instability for \(n<1\) and stability for \(n>1\); the report further records that \(n=0\) gives Hadamard instability, \(0<n<1\) gives tame/Turing-type instability, and \(n>1\) is stabilizing.

title: Squarefree Order Conjecture for reductions of elliptic curves
statement: Let $E/\mathbb{Q}$ be an elliptic curve of conductor $N_E$. For every prime $p\nmid N_E$, let $E_p/\mathbb{F}_p$ be the reduction of $E$ modulo $p$. The report states that this is known when $\operatorname{End}_{\mathbb{Q}}(E)\not\simeq\mathbb{Z}$ and remains open when $\operatorname{End}_{\mathbb{Q}}(E)\simeq\mathbb{Z}$; the latter is the unresolved case.
